name: status-layout
title: StatusLayout
description: Full-page status for 404, 403, 500 and maintenance: a centred message (`code`, `title` as the page h1, `description`) with an illustration or icon halo, a primary and a secondary action, and minimal chrome (optional header with the Logo and a footer line). `tone` colours the code and halo with the severity tokens; brand green is only for positive states. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.
author: gntik-ai
